trust_decision.summary: Composer decides that checkpoint bytes loaded from a user-given path or URI can be fully unpickled: the monolithic torch checkpoint loader passes weights_only=False and the resumption-state loader calls raw pickle.load, so no allowlist of globals is ever applied.

landing_point.why: The summary names checkpoint deserialization. The single torch.load(..., weights_only=False) call in the central helper is the first thing a grep for torch.load/pickle.load finds, and the Trainer load_path flow reaches it through safe_torch_load.

fix_sites.entry_point: Trainer(load_path=..., autoresume=...) -> composer/trainer/trainer.py:1715 checkpoint.load_checkpoint -> safe_torch_load (composer/utils/checkpoint.py:928); also composer.utils.load_checkpoint, LoadCheckpoint callback (composer/callbacks/load_checkpoint.py:64)
safe_torch_load(load_monolith_rank0_only=True), the monolith FSDP rank-0 path, via the same helper; covered implicitly by the helper change
safe_torch_load error handling (the fix adds an 'Unsupported global' -> load_ignore_keys message, fix.diff:166-174)
composer.checkpoint.load_model_checkpoint / load_checkpoint (new checkpoint API, unsharded model) via _torch_load_with_validation
composer.checkpoint.load_checkpoint(load_options={'load_resumption_state': True}) -> load_resumption_checkpoint (composer/checkpoint/load.py:133-136); load_resumption_checkpoint is itself public
fix_sites.module_kind: separate raw-pickle format (resumption.pkl) in the new checkpoint API

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: composer/checkpoint/load.py:641 (resumption.pkl raw pickle.load, written by composer/checkpoint/save.py:283), in the newer composer/checkpoint package, separate from the Trainer's composer/utils/checkpoint.py loader

O3_reason_to_dismiss: resumption.pkl is a plain-pickle side file of the newer, less-used composer.checkpoint API rather than a torch checkpoint, and loading it is opt-in (load_resumption_state defaults to False, composer/checkpoint/load.py:70); for the sharded dist_cp routes (O8), unpickling happens inside PyTorch's torch.distributed.checkpoint FileSystemReader/DefaultLoadPlanner, so a solver can call it 'upstream PyTorch, not Composer'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate full Trainer checkpoints and resumption files hold non-tensor objects: timedelta in timestamp, numpy RNG state (ndarray/dtype/_reconstruct), python random state, TorchVersion in metadata, plus scheduler/callback/algorithm state dicts. A blanket weights_only=True or an over-tight allowlist breaks resuming; the fix adds explicit safe globals and a load_ignore_keys hint for older metric objects.

O6_input_shapes: monolithic torch .pt checkpoint (zip/torch.save format) via torch.load
pickle that embeds torch storage bytes (torch.storage._load_from_bytes nested torch.load), redirected to a weights_only load (fix.diff:41-43, fix.diff:54-55)
numpy 1.x vs 2.x module names for _reconstruct (numpy.core vs numpy._core) and numpy.dtypes subclasses (fix.diff:116-135)

O7_producer.where: composer/checkpoint/state_dict.py:172-217 get_resumption_state_dict and composer/checkpoint/save.py:280-283 (pickle.dump); the Trainer state_dict for .pt files

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Sharded (dist_cp) Trainer load: FileSystemReaderWithValidation.read_metadata delegates to torch dist_cp FileSystemReader.read_metadata, which unpickles .metadata; no allowlist is applied and the fix does not touch it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the unpickling is inside PyTorch's dist_cp reader, and sharded loading requires FSDP; the Composer code only 'validates'
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, different class (~70 lines up); reached from load_sharded_checkpoint composer/utils/checkpoint.py:643-651

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Object-store sharded download: DistCPObjectStoreReader downloads .metadata and shards from a URI, then reads them through the same inherited read_metadata/read_data
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: remote/object-store transport, seen as a download concern rather than deserialization
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; reached via composer/utils/checkpoint.py:636 and composer/checkpoint/load.py:607

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Sharded non-tensor items (rng, timestamp, etc.) go through dist_cp.load with the DefaultLoadPlanner or a user load_planner; byte items are deserialized by the planner, with no Composer allowlist
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: planner behaviour belongs to PyTorch, and a user-provided load_planner is a neighbouring feature
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; also composer/checkpoint/load.py:628 DCP.load in the new API package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: New-API sharded model/optim load (composer.checkpoint.load_model_checkpoint with sharded_checkpoint=True) reads metadata via FileSystemReaderWithValidation without any restriction
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: sharded path in the newer API, 'TODO: Auto-detect sharded', FSDP-only
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: second package (composer/checkpoint) from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: hf_from_composer_checkpoint loading the composer state with its own torch.load instead of safe_torch_load
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: HF conversion helpers often re-implement loading to avoid the Trainer's dist/broadcast logic; at present it delegates to safe_torch_load.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: export_for_inference reading a raw state dict directly for an ONNX/torchscript export
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: export is a standalone utility whose maintainer could plausibly bypass the Trainer helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second pickle-format side file (e.g. dataset/callback state) loaded with pickle.load next to resumption.pkl
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the newer API already writes resumption state as plain pickle (composer/checkpoint/save.py:283), so a similar side file fits the existing idiom.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Flip weights_only=False to True in _torch_load_with_validation and stop, which leaves resumption.pkl raw pickle.load and the sharded dist_cp metadata/bytes routes open and breaks resume for checkpoints holding timedelta/numpy RNG state.

out_of_scope_notes: composer/utils/dist.py:79-97 HPU all_gather path unpickles bytes received from peer ranks (inter-rank channel, a different trust boundary).
composer/utils/checkpoint.py:917 broadcast_object_list pickles state between ranks after the rank-0 load (inter-rank).
download_checkpoint (composer/utils/checkpoint.py:723) extracts tar archives; possible path-traversal concern, a separate weakness.
unverified: That torch 2.6.x dist_cp FileSystemReader.read_metadata uses pickle.load and that DefaultLoadPlanner.load_bytes uses torch.load(weights_only=False): torch sources are not in the pinned tree, so the O8 sinks rest on PyTorch internals.
Whether sharded routes can be exercised on CPU-only with a single process (FileSystemReader.read_metadata likely can; load_sharded_checkpoint requires an FSDP config).
present_in_latest for all O8 routes: no latest release given.

Docs warn 'Do not load checkpoints from untrusted sources' (docs/source/trainer/checkpointing.rst:579-581). This is the opposite of a protection documented without exceptions, but it could weaken the fairness of requiring the sharded routes.
Recall risk: a CVSS 10 CVE on a popular ML library is probably widely indexed; the extent of write-ups was not checked.
